svg.title: A small constant changes the function
svg.desc: Distinguish defined zero-vector behavior from invalid configuration and tiny signals. The teaching API requires finite positive epsilon. Zero input gives zero output. Exact scale invariance does not hold with fixed positive epsilon.
svg.text: A small constant changes the function
Distinguish defined zero-vector behavior from invalid configuration and tiny signals.
Analytical output scale relative to alpha = 1
The teaching API requires finite positive epsilon. Zero input gives zero output.
Exact scale invariance does not hold with fixed positive epsilon.
